items.title: Felt Reindeer Bookmark
items.alt: Tall rust-colored felt reindeer bookmark with closed embroidered eyes, a green bow tie and two complete stitched antlers.
items.description: Long cream belly panels and slender legs give the bookmark a narrow vertical shape. Small dark felt hooves and visible blanket stitches outline the decorative animal.

items.title: Reindeer Christmas Snow Globe
items.alt: Clear snow globe containing a small prancing reindeer above a green evergreen-style base with a red bow and gold trim.
items.description: White snow specks surround the miniature animal inside the complete glass dome. Layered green branches, a large red bow and gold edging decorate the base.

items.title: Reindeer Pulling an Empty Sleigh Outline
items.alt: Black-and-white cartoon reindeer looking back while pulling an empty sleigh through a simple connected harness.
items.description: Long antlers and a short scarf rise above the reindeer's lifted forehoof. Sweeping double runners and an open seat distinguish the empty sleigh behind it.

items.title: Two Reindeer Friends Outline
items.alt: Black-and-white cartoon of two different reindeer seated back-to-back, one tall and surprised and the other round and laughing.
items.description: Contrasting body proportions, antlers and expressions distinguish the two friends. Folded rear legs and long front legs create an open coloring composition.

items.title: Reindeer with an Empty Star Frame Outline
items.alt: Black-and-white reindeer bust leaning above a large empty five-point star frame, with two forehooves resting on its top edges.
items.description: A smiling freckled muzzle and wide antlers rise above the open star. One lowered ear and a loose forelock give the head a playful asymmetric shape.

items.title: Reindeer Baker with Cookie Tray Outline
items.alt: Black-and-white upright cartoon reindeer wearing an apron and holding a tray of three cookies, with a small mixing bowl beside one hoof.
items.description: Short antlers, large oval eyes and a scalloped apron distinguish the cheerful baker. The separate bowl and complete cookie tray leave clear open areas for coloring.
